none: PAS FindID 865490: Harness Mount - incomplete possible Roman copper alloy pendant
contea di ritrovamento: Northamptonshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete possible Roman copper alloy pendant with a double circular base, with each circular section containing an inscribed circle which lies each side of a central line, and a shaped top. Each circle containing -possibly- a spiral pattern starting from a small hole in the centre, or a series of separate circles within the main outer circle.
